name: @potyro/platform-requests
author: Edgar Zanella Alvarenga
description: Requests to the Potyro team for what Potyro itself lacks (#263): the payload the Studio sends (browser-safe), and the small server-side relay that files them as GitHub issues in fuzue/potyro, labelled platform-request, rate-limited per device, size-capped and grouped by duplicates. Depends on no Potyro package. Deployment: docs/16.
